statements.text: For example, a populated board for a computer points toward heading 8473, and a populated board for telecommunications apparatus toward the parts provisions of heading 8517.

Thin- or thick-film circuits comprising passive and active elements obtained during the same technological process are to be classified in heading 8542.

For the purposes of this section, the term "printed circuit assembly"means goods consisting of one or more printed circuits of heading 8534 with one or more active elements assembled thereon, with or without passive elements.

The term "printed circuits" does not cover circuits combined with elements other than those obtained during the printing process, nor does it cover individual, discrete resistors, capacitors or inductances.
Bare printed circuit boards have their own heading, 8534, which covers 'printed circuits'; boards with conductive tracks, but before electronic components are mounted.

Once components (resistors, capacitors, integrated circuits and the like) are soldered onto the board to create a printed circuit assembly (PCBA), the populated board takes on the character of a part of a finished article and is generally classified as a part of the machine or apparatus it is destined for.
For the purposes of this note,"active elements" means diodes, transistors and similar semiconductor devices, whether or not photosensitive, of heading 8541, and integrated circuits of heading 8542.
